hooks.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude"; for d in skills agents; do [ -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/$d" ] && { [ -L "$HOME/.claude/$d" ] || [ ! -e "$HOME/.claude/$d" ]; } && ln -sfn "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/$d" "$HOME/.claude/$d"; done; true
command -v tokens >/dev/null && TZ=Asia/Singapore TOKENS_API_TOKEN="${TOKENS_API_TOKEN:-egress-proxy}" timeout 30 tokens cloud submit >/dev/null 2>&1; true
